assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one square seamless tileable sRGB albedo texture for a stylized low-poly Three.js game, SIGNAL / 47, New Mexico 1986. Primary request: warm brown and muted ochre hexagonal vinyl floor tiles with subtly worn dark grout. Straight orthographic top-down view, surface fills the entire square image. Several evenly sized tessellating hexagonal tiles across the image, clean repeating geometry; modest irregular material scuffs and small chips around the grout, restrained simple hand-painted game texture rather than photorealism. Medium muted warm tan/brown values, no glossy highlights. Make opposite image edges line up exactly in shape and color so the texture repeats seamlessly in both X and Y without visible boundaries. Flat unlit base color only; no directional lighting, no ambient occlusion gradient, no shadows, no vignette, no perspective, no frame, no objects, no labels, no letters, no symbols, no watermark. Target final size 1024x1024.

assets.edit_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: attached original hexagonal vinyl floor albedo texture. Correct only the registration of the tessellating hexagon pattern at the four image boundaries so a 2x2 repeat has NO interrupted grout, NO mismatch in tile color across a seam, NO line at any square image boundary. Presently the bottom and top rows do not quite align when repeated. Make exact whole repeat periods fit the square image; you may gently regularize the hexagonal grid to achieve exact repetition. Keep the warm ochre/brown palette, matte stylized 1986 vinyl material, subtle wear, same amount of dark grout, flat orthographic composition. No lighting, gradient, vignette, shadow, perspective, text, frame or object. Produce ONE corrected square tileable texture, not a preview grid. True seamless X and Y repetition is the only requested change. Final target 1024x1024.
